text: Figure 6.8: Data message. Here, it is worth emphasizing, that the VDP-CM Remote responds (ideally) with one data message to all requests received. In this data message, all previously acquired data samples are aggregated and sent to the data consumer. An example with three different samples whereof one reported an asynchronous error for one sample is depicted in figure 6.9.
